public_input.note: The only public file is the coordinate-free target specification. The agent must generate every coordinate and all first-principles data.

system.json.role: coordinate-free system identity (64 H2O, 12.4 A cubic cell, DeePMD)

expert_trajectory.note: reference/expert-trajectory/ is the hidden 5-stage lineage. aimd/raw hashes below were computed on the committed copies and match the ai2kit/data/cp2k-aimd/output/ originals byte-for-byte (the old design locked the same values). Other files are byte-for-byte copies verified with cmp at construction time.

hidden_validation.note: No new HPC run required: the hidden set is derived from the expert 190-frame AIMD mother set (aimd/processed/aimd.xyz), which the agent can never train on because the public input is only the unrelaxed PACKMOL structure. Generator: reference/hidden-validation/generator/generate_hidden_validation.py. manifest.json now carries per_frame_provenance[] (raw_aimd_step, time_fs, temperature_K, energy_hartree, selected, filter_reason, annotated_duplicate_step, coords_hash_prec3).

source_artifacts.note: source/ holds formal case-level input + parser artifacts (Acceptance Board A1): source/input-manifest.json freezes the single public file (system.json, coordinate-free); source/structure_parse.py is a dependency-free independent parser for the hidden expert initial structure whose deterministic output structure-parse.json is a re-checkable fingerprint.

source/input-manifest.json.role: formal public-input manifest (path, size, sha256, role, atoms, cell)

source/structure_parse.py.role: dependency-free independent parser for the hidden expert initial structure reference/expert-trajectory/initial/water64.xyz

source/structure-parse.json.role: deterministic parse output (192/64/128 PASS, bounds, cell)
